photos.llama_desc: A man in a white shirt and black tie standing on a stage with two people in animal costumes. The man is standing in front of a large, darkly lit stage with a few people in the background. The man is wearing a white shirt, black tie, and dark pants.

Two young girls in matching white t-shirts with a red, white, and blue star on the front, standing in a grassy area with a sidewalk and a blue car in the background. The girl on the left has her hair in a ponytail and is wearing a pair of black-framed glasses. The girl on the right has a red, white, and blue hair bow in her hair.

A woman in a red Santa hat and red coat, holding a bell, standing in front of a group of children in a room with a Christmas tree and a table with books and toys. The children are all dressed in various Christmas-themed clothing, including red and green, and some are holding small toys or books. The room is decorated with a Christmas tree and a table with books and toys, and there is an American flag in the background.

A group of women and a young girl in a pink leotard sitting on a gymnastics beam in a gym. The women are all wearing blue t-shirts with green text on them, and one of them is wearing a pink t-shirt. The girl is wearing a pink leotard and has a bandage on her knee.

A young woman in a green dress and high heels, holding a white and green corsage, standing with a young man in a black tuxedo, green bow tie, and white shirt, in front of a tree with a large trunk and green leaves.
Two people in a darkened theater watching a stage show with a large, green, glowing, and spiky, flower-like, or plant-like, structure in the center of the stage.

A young girl in a pink and yellow swimsuit sits in a sandcastle on a beach, throwing sand in the air. She has long blonde hair and is wearing a pink and yellow swimsuit with a yellow and pink beach towel around her neck. The sandcastle is made of several large and small pieces of sand, with some of it being thrown in the air.

A young girl in a black dress with pink flowers, holding a bunch of purple balloons in a living room with a couch, a brick fireplace, and a TV. She is standing on a rug with a floral pattern, holding the balloons with both hands. The room has a TV on a TV stand, a lamp on a table, and a fireplace with a few framed photos on the mantel.

A red train car with three children sitting in it, looking out at something. The train car is red and has a metal pole running along its top. The children are all wearing different outfits: a girl in a pink dress, a boy in a white t-shirt, and a girl in a pink and white checkered dress.
A woman in a white dress crouing next to a birdbath in a garden. She is holding a small blue bird in her hands. The woman is wearing a white dress and has long dark hair.
